description: A shell script implementing automated tests for integrating Git with Perforce (p4). It sets up a p4 server, creates jobs, adds files, clones repositories, and verifies commit messages related to job associations and changelists.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server instance.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce job with a specified identifier.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up the client view mappings in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce within the specified client workspace.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using git-p4.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up temporary Git repositories created during tests.

methods.name: p4 fix
methods.description: Associates a job with a particular changelist.
